name: repeat-1
source: written for the superseded field, after a live session left four open copies of the restart question
prompt: fix the narrow footer, then install it

open.title: Restart the panel to load the new build?
Add the eval results to the README?

message:
Fixed: the footer now wraps its hints instead of cutting them off at 80 columns, and the health warning keeps its count visible. Tests pass, and `go install ./cmd/rexq` put the new binary in place.

The panel you have open is still the old build, so you won't see the fix until it restarts. Should I restart it for you now (it closes and reopens in the same floating layer), or will you do it when you're done with it?
